DECL	{"assumptions":[],"binders":["subject"],"id":"NRS_484D_165_3","intentions":[],"laws":["NRS-484D-165-3"],"narrowings":[],"operationalizations":[],"residues":["'whether attended or unattended' covers both states: the duty is the same whether or not anyone attends the vehicle.","The equipment duty and the lamps' colour (white or amber to the front, red to the rear) and reach (visible from 500 feet) describe the lamps the obligation requires displayed; no atom carries a lamp's colour, reach or fitment, so the rule reads only that the position lamps are lit.","The location of the lamps (one as near as practicable to the side closest to passing traffic) is a fitment requirement no atom carries; the rule does not read it."],"surrogate":false}
